summary: Fairfax filed a Form 6-K (US equivalent of a Canadian material-change/news release) announcing TSX acceptance of a Normal Course Issuer Bid (NCIB), the Canadian analogue of a US buyback program, for its Subordinate Voting Shares and Series K preferred shares. The board authorized purchases from September 30, 2026 to September 29, 2027, capped at approximately 10% of public float: 2,025,315 Subordinate Voting Shares and 950,000 Series K Shares, with daily limits of 15,137 and 2,226, respectively. Series K shares are fully held by the public float; purchased shares are cancelled.
